breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still includes 'with a half shift' when describing the k-point grid ('Use a gamma-centered automatic Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid of 8x8x6 dimensions with a half shift'). The ground truth resolves this conflict by removing the half-shift instruction entirely, leaving only the gamma-centered grid requirement. The agent repeated the original error by combining both contradictory instructions.
